text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Mainichi Okan is here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just before the race starts, Special Week approaches Silence Suzuka with messages from both El Condor Pasa and Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her fellow racers' impassioned messages energize Silence Suzuka, and she steps onto the track with her head held high.
